company_name: Sae Han Micro Tech Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Sae Han Micro Tech Co., Ltd. provides essential materials and chemicals for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Sae Han Micro Tech Co., Ltd. is a key supplier in the semiconductor industry, offering a range of materials and chemicals crucial for various manufacturing processes. Their product portfolio includes surface protection materials, coatings, photoresists, developers, adhesion promoters, primers, anti-reflective coatings, finished and patterned photo masks, and lead frames and headers.
